quotes.text: Letting go is not giving up; it is choosing peace.
Some people come into your life to teach you how to walk away.
A broken heart still knows how to heal.
The end of a relationship is not the end of your worth.
Cry if you need to, then rise stronger than before.
You lost someone, but you found yourself.
Healing takes time, and you deserve every moment of it.
Close the chapter gently; your story is far from over.
